name: traffic
description: Live users per app across the whole {host}/{mod} router, and how that changes over time. Tails Caddy's JSON access log, counts distinct people (anonymous salted hash of client IP + browser, bots and the box itself left out) per app per minute in a local SQLite file, and charts it: who is on which app right now, and users over 1H/6H/24H/7D/30D per app.

endpoints.GET /live: People on each app in the last `window` seconds (default 300) + total across all sites
endpoints.GET /series: Users per bucket per app over a range (range=1h|6h|24h|7d|30d, top=8, apps=a,b) + full app table
endpoints.GET /sparks: Every app's per-bucket users for the range (table sparklines)
endpoints.GET /info: What this is, which log it reads
